caption: Figure 6.5: Kottke dielectric subpixel smoothing in GridFIT3D. Left: across a curved dielectric interface with normal n̂ cutting dual cell Ṽ_k, tangential E_∥ and normal D_⊥ = ε E_⊥ are continuous; Wakis evaluates volume averages ⟨f⟩ over Ṽ_k with m³ = 4³ = 64 subcell quadrature samples (conformal_subsamples=4). Centre: conformal='all' uses the diagonal entries T_{xx}, T_{yy}, T_{zz} with zero runtime overhead. Right: conformal='tensor' applies the full symmetric tensor T via an 8-octant gather/scatter operator solver.ieps_tensor to restore O(h²) accuracy on tilted high-contrast interfaces.
visual_intent:
Textbook-quality scientific schematic for a computational electromagnetics user manual. Flat vector style on a white background, high contrast, thin dark outlines, generous whitespace, sans-serif labels. Colour code used in every figure: primary grid G and its quantities in blue, dual grid G-tilde and its quantities in orange, exact/topological items in dark grey, approximate/material items in green, failure or warning items in red. Colourblind-safe. Every label must be spelled exactly as listed in this brief; mathematical symbols must be typeset correctly (hats, tildes, subscripts, transposes). Do not add any number, value, equation, software name, product name, logo, watermark or title that is not listed in this brief. Prefer fewer, larger labels over many small ones. No 3D photorealism, no cartoon characters, no hand-drawn or xkcd style.

Three panels side by side. LEFT PANEL (heading '1. Cut dual cell Ṽ_k & Kottke tensor'): a square dual cell Ṽ_k (orange dashed border) cut by a tilted curved interface between dielectric 'ε₁' (white) and dielectric 'ε₂' (light green), with unit normal arrow 'n̂', tangential vector arrow 'E_∥ continuous', and normal vector arrow 'D_⊥ = ε E_⊥ continuous'. Overlay a 4 × 4 grid of small orange dots inside Ṽ_k labelled 'conformal_subsamples=4 (4³ = 64 quadrature points in 3D)'. Below the cell, the exact equation 'T = ⟨ε⁻¹⟩ n̂ n̂ᵀ + ⟨ε⟩⁻¹ (I − n̂ n̂ᵀ)'. CENTRE PANEL (blue border, heading '2. Diagonal Kottke: conformal="all"'): a primary cell with three uncoupled edge arrows E_x, E_y, E_z along the coordinate axes, and formula 'solver.ieps uses diagonal entries: T_{cc} = n_c² ⟨ε⁻¹⟩ + (1 − n_c²) ⟨ε⟩⁻¹'. At the bottom, two green badges: 'O(h²) for axis-aligned or moderate contrast' and 'zero runtime overhead after setup'. RIGHT PANEL (green border, heading '3. Full Symmetric Tensor: conformal="tensor"'): a 3D primary cube subdivided into 8 octants around a 45°-tilted interface, with one octant highlighted showing its three adjacent edge components (E_x, E_y, E_z in blue) gathered into the octant, coupled by off-diagonal arrows 'T_{ab} = (⟨ε⁻¹⟩ − ⟨ε⟩⁻¹) n_a n_b  (a ≠ b)', and scattered back by the transpose ('solver.ieps_tensor'). At the bottom, two badges: green badge '8-octant SPD gather/scatter: O(h²) on 45° high-contrast interfaces' and grey badge '+15% step cost on GPU, +5% on CPU'.
